title: Security
description: SSH, sudo, fail2ban, and UFW security event monitoring.

targets.expr: {job=~"ssh|fail2ban|ufw|crowdsec|appsec|honeypot"} geoip_country_code:!"" | stats by (geoip_country_code) count() as count
{job=~"ssh|fail2ban|ufw|crowdsec|appsec|honeypot"} geoip_country_code:!"" | stats by (geoip_country_code, job) count() as count
{job="ssh",host=~"$instance"} event_type:~"invalid_user|preauth|failed" | stats by (client_ip, geoip_country_name) count() as count | sort by (count) desc | limit 20
{job="ssh",host=~"$instance"} event_type:~"invalid_user|preauth|failed" | stats by (username) count() as count | sort by (count) desc | limit 10
{job="ssh",host=~"$instance"} event_type:~"invalid_user|preauth|failed" | stats by (geoip_country_name) count() as count | sort by (count) desc | limit 10
{job="fail2ban",host=~"$instance"} action:"Ban" | stats by (jail) count() as count | sort by (count) desc | limit 10
{job="fail2ban",host=~"$instance"} action:"Ban" | stats by (client_ip, geoip_country_name) count() as count | sort by (count) desc | limit 20
{job="ufw",host=~"$instance"} action:"BLOCK" | stats by (dst_port) count() as count | sort by (count) desc | limit 20
{job="ufw",host=~"$instance"} action:"BLOCK" | stats by (client_ip, geoip_country_name) count() as count | sort by (count) desc | limit 20
